adaptiveRules.trigger: Within-session timing spread above 3%, or failure to bracket VMAF90 reference anchor
adaptiveRules.curveExpansion: At most two additional native RC values per implementation/preset/workload, declared before new runs and never chosen from held-out outcomes
adaptiveRules.failure: Remain unvalidated on unresolved variance, unbracketed anchor, incompatible exact device/toolchain or missing implementation; no substitute encoder

predeclaredAcceptance.goldenChoices: Every reviewed Balanced/Quality/Storage/Realtime comparison agrees with production ranking under its hard constraints; report ties and all rejected choices. No post-hoc criteria changes.
predeclaredAcceptance.holdouts: Every named fold uses group-disjoint fitting/evaluation IDs, a separately fitted retained frontier artifact and production-ranker predicted choice confirmed by a knowledgeable reviewer. Any systematic inversion blocks activation.
predeclaredAcceptance.metricDisagreement: Every investigated case resolved by an exact-analysis append-only operator review or explicitly excluded from all fitting/frontier/ranking evidence.
predeclaredAcceptance.physicalSource: At least two persistent physical-source pseudonyms; sessions and environment hashes do not count as new machines.
predeclaredAcceptance.humanReview: Blank identities/judgments remain blank until supplied by genuine knowledgeable reviewers.
predeclaredAcceptance.singleHardwareSource: A hardware family observed on one physical source stays below any policy requiring independent-machine corroboration; additional campaigns cannot repair this.
